request.description: One requirement with its version summaries. Staff only. Document requirements are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets: an ops lead makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then it is published). `content`: `stage` (`assessment`, `submission`, `post_sanction`), `scope` (`segments`, `subSegments`, `categories`; empty = everyone) and `items[]` slots: `key`, `documentTypes` (any one of them satisfies the slot), `required` (default true), `minCount` (default 1), optional `when` condition on facts, and `label` / `description` overrides. A more specific requirement replaces a slot with the same key.
